'''Aush''' <!--WP:COMMONNAME--> ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|ɔː|ʃ|,_|ˈ|ɑː|ʃ|}} {{respell|AWSH, AHSH}}; {{langx|fa|آش}} {{IPA|fa|ˈɒːʃ|}}), properly [[Romanization of Persian|romanized]] as '''{{translit|fa|āsh}}''', is a variety of thick soup, usually served hot. It is part of [[Iranian cuisine]] and [[Afghan cuisine]], and is also found in [[Azerbaijani cuisine|Azerbaijani]],<ref name=":2">{{Cite book |last=Marks |first=Gil |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gFK_yx7Ps7cC |title=Encyclopedia of Jewish Food |date=2010-11-17 |publisher=HMH |isbn=978-0-544-18631-6 |location= |pages=142 |language=en}}</ref> [[Turkey|Turkish]],<ref>{{cite web | url=https://pakistanatlas.com/food/aush/ | title=Aush | Pakistan Atlas }}</ref> and [[Caucasian cuisine|South Caucasian]] cuisines.<ref name=":2" />
